## Release notes

### Fixed
- **A run that the agent starts inside a run stops at once** (#76). If the agent ran pi-action again from its tools, the second run changed the thread refs under the first, and the first run failed. pi-action now sets `PI_ACTION_RUNNING` while it runs and does not start when it is set. See [A run inside a run](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.5.1/docs/security.md#a-run-inside-a-run).
EOF
